about: The real visitors' questions from the first 16 conversations (4-20 Oct 2026), as a regression set for the template answers (owner, 2026-10-20). Run: REGRESSION_QUESTIONS=backend/tests/real_questions.json python3 backend/tests/regression.py tools OUT.json. must/must_not are case-insensitive regexes. The company blacklist (Beyond Madeira, GetToHikes, Doit, Happy Transfer, Madeira Transfers) guards the no-referrals rule; 'sexta a domingo' and 'closed section' guard the 19 Oct and 6 Oct wrong answers.
